Please don’t fall for the lack of 1 star reviews he deleted over 300 claiming they were fraudulent

Killed my dog out of sheer stupidity and negligence in their care.

Doesn't really get worse than that.
Should be shut down.

The best part is the owner is so unprofessional I'm sure this will be met with some petty reply about how it's someone else's fault.

Avoid at all costs.

Hello, to all who may read this.  I was introduced to Jeff through my veterinary office (Best Friends Pets, Monrovia) as a reputable dog handler/trainer.  When I first called Jeff, I originally had a 9-year-old German Shepard and Jeff was honest with me about the age of my dog and how my financial resources would be better suited in other areas.

This prompted my attention, as he could have said “yes, let’s start next week”, took my money and left me wondering why my dog would not pick up the training properly ----after multiple conversations, he informed me that it would be more suitable for my situation to wait until I got a much younger dog.  Jeff was never pushy with sales, he provided enough information for me to make a well-informed decision about dog training and the investment of time, resources, and finances.

Well, I did not believe this would happen anytime soon, but due to the Eaton Fires, the stress alone from moving several times and not being home for months, my dog succumbed to his stress.   We took a few months off and were gifted an 8-week-old German Shepard.

After the proper shots, we called Jeff back and set up a date to begin training.   To my surprise, the training was the most challenging thing I have put myself through.  I say this, because every other challenge involved things I could maneuver around myself, now put an animal who is just learning life in new environments, it was challenging. During the training, I was listening to Jeff, learning new things I never knew (leash handling, ‘proper’ corrections, and being very, very, very, consistent in how I handle my dog).  These dogs are incredibly smart and will take a mile for every inch you give them.  At times, I was frustrated, not with the training, but the mere fact that I understand the concept but could not properly put it into practice.

My last dog, we never trained, never took around ppl, etc., this dog we wanted to do more with her and it was tough.  I liked that Jeff and Jalen, were calm, cool, and collective.  They would tell me, “Well this is what we recommend, but this is your dog and you are going to do what you want with her”.

The first three paragraphs were written within a week of completion of the original training.  Now, a few months later, I am reaping the benefits of being consistent, constantly training, and my dog is becoming the dog that I want. Jeff welcomes check-ins,  follow up questions, and   I would highly recommend Jeff and his team, I look forward to my next training block.

We had an amazing experience with Jeff and Jalen at Smart Dogs Training! They boarded and trained our Goldendoodle, Zion, and we couldn't be happier with the results. Zion came home well behaved, listens much better, and it's clear they spent a lot of time and care working with him. Jeff and Jalen were professional, knowledgeable, and genuinely cared about Zion throughout the process. We highly recommend Smart Dogs Training to anyone looking for real dog trainers!

I paid 100$ to have someone come out and address a specific problem i was having with my dogs. My concerns were not addressed in any meaningful way. I was charged for the time anyway despite the fact that at no point were my concerns even discussed. I would not recommend this person.

Jeff and Jalen have truly changed our lives. My dog is very energetic 8 years old Labrador retriever and I thought his habits were already set for good. He used to pull very hard on walks, jump on guests, and could not stay in place for more than a few minutes. After their 4-week board-and-train program, the transformation has been incredible. He now walks calmly by my side, sits on command, and stays in place while we eat. It honestly feels like he has been reborn.

Seeing this kind of change in an older dog is something I never thought possible, and it means so much to me. But what impressed me even more was how much Jeff and Jalen cared about making the results last. They did several training sessions with me as well, making sure I knew exactly how to continue the training at home and reinforce everything consistently. They did not just hand my dog back to me and walk away, they made sure we were both set up for success.

Their patience, dedication, knowledge, and genuine care are extraordinary. You can tell they love what they do, and they are truly gifted at it. I am beyond thankful for everything they have done for us, and I highly recommend them with all my heart.

These men did a great job with my Aussie Doodle pup.  I am going back to them for more training and also bringing my seven year old Aussie Doodle too - he needs some fine tuning that these men can easily take care of.  I highly recommend them.

Jeff’s approach to training was exactly what I needed for my pit mix who developed behavioral issues in her teenage years. He coached me through effective obedience training and after just one or two sessions I was able to manage my dog in these more challenging situations and started seeing results. I saw a couple different trainers before Jeff and really nothing compares to his approach. My life’s been made so much easier because of his training. Can’t recommend enough!

Jeff and Jalen changed my life! I felt so overwhelmed with having a puppy and two older dogs, and they not only shaped the dogs’ behavior but gave me the skills that I needed to feel confident and in control of the pack. I highly recommend them to anyone with a dog who could use a little bit of molding and support!

We have a high energy ACD that couldn't get along with our other dogs and was reactive on walks.  I was not about to give up on her.  Jeff and his staff worked on empowering us to be the best parents we could be.  He showed us where we fell short and helped us to be confident in walking.  He also helped me to get where I can play fetch with her and not get attacked (typical cattle dog behavior IYKTYK).

We are still working on desensitizing and reactivity.  So the process is not finished.

SmartDogs saved my dog’s life.

We adopted Sir Charles, 50 lb pit (not our first), in May. After a few weeks, we were on the brink of returning him to the shelter. He ran away. He ate everything. But the realest concern was his 10/10 aggression towards other dogs. Owning a pit requires being responsible for the safety of everyone around the dog at all times and Sir Charles was one leash slip away from making everyone unsafe.

Enter SmartDogs. Jeff made himself available immediately. He listened. He let me know, up front, to not expect a happy go lucky dog waltzing through the tulips - maybe ever. He gave me straight forward, easy to follow lessons and principles. He kept listening. We made adjustments. When a tactic failed, first Jeff corrected my mistakes. Then, if it failed again, we moved on.

Sir Charles is still A LOT. He may never be able to integrate fully with our other dogs - a fact I can handle, in large part, because of the realistic expectations Jeff and his excellent assistant Jalen set out when we began and have managed throughout the process.

I can not recommend SmartDogs enough ❤️
